construction.salt: 32 zero bytes (an empty salt is the same HMAC key)
construction.string: standard Base64 with padding, 60 characters; the unpadded 59-character form is accepted

plaintext_layout: u8 flags (bit0 allow, bit1 withdraw, bit2 learning, bit3 verifying, bits 4 to 7 zero)
u8 route class (0 unknown, 1 ear, 2 speaker, 3 bt, 4 wired, 5 car)

seal_cases.name: flags_none
seal_cases.description: allow = 0, withdraw = 0: nothing is learned or checked for the sender in this call

seal_cases.name: withdraw
seal_cases.description: withdraw = 1 with allow = 0: read as allow = 0, and the record of the sender is deleted
